name: grail-layers
purpose: Updates for every Brainstem that install over the unchanged grail and can fail without breaking it. A supervisor applies each layer in memory at start, probes /chat, and falls back to plain grail on any failure. First layer: Responses-API models (gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna) work in the unchanged grail.

parts.what: Models that only speak the Responses API (gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna) become usable in the unchanged grail.

install.parts_note: rapp-rar-stack/1.2: `parts` is the current list (publisher-scoped ids, kind layer|kernel, one point each, sha256 + locator; the installer seeds the device's rapp/1 chain from it). `layers`, `default_enabled` and `proven_grail` are kept as an alias of `parts` for older installers; status: alias, retiring when a measured check shows zero readers.
